arguments.analyst: Observations show large context-dependent effects: O1 (3.867) and O2 (3.856) are bright, O4/O5 (~1.30) are dim. Menu predictions cluster near 3.57-3.60; conservative single-class swaps with low overlap counts are the safest bets.
arguments.hypothesis: Brightness in this set is driven by beneficial residue-specific effects rather than edit count; conservative class-matched edits (e.g., K41R, K158R, N164S, K156R) preserve bright fluorescence, while menus with proline/charged-pocket disruptions (L60P, L64P, S65P) are dim.

decision.analyst: Observations show large context-dependent effects: O1 (3.867) and O2 (3.856) are bright, O4/O5 (~1.30) are dim. Menu predictions cluster near 3.57-3.60; conservative single-class swaps with low overlap counts are the safest bets.
decision.hypothesis: Brightness in this set is driven by beneficial residue-specific effects rather than edit count; conservative class-matched edits (e.g., K41R, K158R, N164S, K156R) preserve bright fluorescence, while menus with proline/charged-pocket disruptions (L60P, L64P, S65P) are dim.
decision.critic: C40's L60P conflicts with O4/O5 proline-dim evidence; its estimate (3.577) may be optimistic. C34 uncertainty (0.469) is high.
decision.selection_rationale: Top estimates: C32 (3.608), C01 (3.601), C31 (3.599), C41 (3.587) all low-uncertainty conservative edits. C40 included to test the proline hypothesis despite dim precedent.
